e.title: bank-in-domains：印度金融命名空间（含 .insurance.in）的域名层每日探测数据集
e.title_en: bank-in-domains: a daily domain-layer probe dataset for Indian financial namespaces, including .insurance.in
e.title_hk: bank-in-domains：印度金融命名空間（含 .insurance.in）的域名層每日探測數據集
e.summary: 每日对 .bank.in、.fin.in、.insurance.in、.nbfc.in、.npci.in 与全球 .bank gTLD 做 DNS 解析、HTTPS 可达性、状态码、页面标题与最终 URL 探测的数据集，实测 4,199 条，提供 CSV/JSONL/Parquet/SQLite 四种格式，由 GitHub Actions 每日更新；起因是没有权威登记机构公布这些子域名清单
e.summary_en: A dataset probing .bank.in, .fin.in, .insurance.in, .nbfc.in, .npci.in and the global .bank gTLD daily for DNS resolution, HTTPS reachability, status codes, page titles and final URLs — measured at 4,199 entries, published as CSV, JSONL, Parquet and SQLite, and updated daily by GitHub Actions; it exists because no authoritative registry publishes these subdomain lists
e.summary_hk: 每日對 .bank.in、.fin.in、.insurance.in、.nbfc.in、.npci.in 與全球 .bank gTLD 做 DNS 解析、HTTPS 可達性、狀態碼、頁面標題與最終 URL 探測的數據集，實測 4,199 條，提供 CSV/JSONL/Parquet/SQLite 四種格式，由 GitHub Actions 每日更新；起因是沒有權威登記機構公布這些子域名清單
e.body:
**bank-in-domains** 是一份**印度金融命名空间的域名层每日探测数据集**（仓库 `CCAgentOrg/bank-in-domains`），**实测 ★10、fork 2、主语言 Python、仓库体量 4,007 KB、创建于 2026-06-07、最后推送 2026-09-10**（**均 GitHub API 实测值**）；**其自述主页实测为 `zo.pub/cashlessconsumer/bank-domains-status`**。本条目属于本轮主题**「可核实性的四种做法」**中的**第三种：靠持续测量（measurement）****。

可核实信息（**均由 GitHub API 与 README 逐字实测**）：**README 实测 11,172 字节**，其要点逐字为 **「Audit of Indian financial namespace TLDs. Daily probes of `.bank.in`, `.fin.in`, `.insurance.in`, `.nbfc.in`, `.npci.in`, and the global `.bank` gTLD — DNS resolution, HTTPS reachability, status codes, page titles, and final URLs.」**——**即每日探测这些命名空间的**DNS 解析、HTTPS 可达性、状态码、页面标题与最终 URL****。⭐ **README 徽章逐字实测给出三项关键指标**：**License: CC0-1.0**、**Updated Daily**、**Entries 4,199**；**并提供格式徽章 CSV / JSONL / Parquet / SQLite**；**另实测「Built with Zo」徽章**。⭐ **README 逐字说明了它存在的原因**：**「`.bank.in` is the de-facto namespace for Indian banking web presences, but no authoritative registry publishes a subdomain list. This audit discovers and [monitors]」**——**即「`.bank.in` 是印度银行业网络存在的**事实标准**命名空间，但**没有任何权威登记机构公布其子域名清单**，故这份审计自行发现并持续监测」。

对 RIAA：**① ⭐⭐⭐ 「权威登记机构不公布清单，所以只能自己持续测量」是本轮最有方法论价值的一条**——**这是「**没有官方名单**」这一常见困境的一种解法：**不去猜、不去引用二手名单，而是每天自己探一遍并把结果公开****；**对精算与保险学生，这个模式可迁移到很多场景**（**例如「市场上哪些机构真的提供某类产品」「哪些监管者页面真的可达」——**本词条所在站点的每一条目也是靠这种逐次实测建立的**）。**② ⭐⭐ `.insurance.in` 直接出现在探测范围内**——**即存在一个**面向保险业网络存在的印度命名空间**，而它与 `.bank.in`、`.nbfc.in`（非银行金融公司）、`.npci.in`（印度国家支付公司）并列**；**对做印度保险市场或金融监管研究的学生，这是一个此前池内没有的**基础设施视角****（**可与池内 [[irdai-sbsr-regulations]]、[[irdai-market-statistics]]、[[irdai-ai-governance]] 并读——**那三条是 IRDAI 的规则、统计与 AI 治理，而本条补的是**这些机构的网络存在本身是否可达、是否解析****；**「监管者发过文件」与「监管者的网站真的活着」是两件事**）。**③ ⭐⭐ 「DNS 解析 + HTTPS 可达性 + 状态码 + 页面标题 + 最终 URL」五项合起来，正好构成本词条所在站点验证流程的机器化版本**——**尤其「最终 URL」一项：**跳转后的落点常常与名义 URL 不同**，这与本轮反复出现的**域名级近失**（第 310 轮 `gfia.org`、第 317 轮 `cios.org`）是同一类风险**；**本数据集等于把「这个域名到底指向谁」做成了每日例行测量**。**④ ⭐ 「Entries 4,199」与四种格式（CSV/JSONL/Parquet/SQLite）说明它是**可直接用于分析**的形态**——**对做数据工程或需要真实金融域名清单的学生，这四个格式覆盖了表格、流式、列式与查询四类用法**（**可与池内 [[open-risk-api]]、[[risk-data-library-standard]]、[[cybrisk]] 所代表的开放风险数据与标准并读**）。**⑤ ⭐ 「Updated Daily」由 GitHub Actions 实现，是一种低成本持续测量架构**——**与池内 [[daily-news-report]] 的每日产出、[[continuous-monitoring-ai-risk]] 的持续监控同属「让测量变成流水线而不是一次性工作」**（**本次未查看其 workflow 文件，故不转述其实现细节**）。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**① ⚠️ 许可存在**来源冲突，须并列如实记录****：**GitHub API 实测返回 `NOASSERTION`（name 为 `Other`）**，**而 README 徽章逐字实测为 `License: CC0-1.0`**——**两者不一致**；**本词条据此并列记录，并提示：引用该数据前应自行核对仓库中的实际许可文件与条款**（**不断言其为 CC0，也不断言其不可用**）。**②** 本次核实的是**仓库元数据、README 全文（11,172 字节）与其中逐字引用的徽章数值与描述**，⭐ **但未下载任何数据文件、未打开 CSV/JSONL/Parquet/SQLite 中的任何一条记录、未访问其自述主页 `zo.pub/cashlessconsumer/bank-domains-status`**，因此**不能转述其字段定义、4,199 条的实际构成、探测成功率或历史覆盖**；**③ ⭐ 「Entries 4,199」与「Updated Daily」均为**README 徽章自述值**，**本次未核对数据文件以验证条数，也未核对提交历史以验证是否真的每日更新**；**④ 「no authoritative registry publishes a subdomain list」为**项目自述的判断****——**本词条不主张该判断已被独立证实**（**这正是一个需要读者自己核实的制度性主张**）；**⑤ 该数据集的采集方式、探测频率的精确值、是否遵守目标站点的访问策略本次未核实**；**⑥ 探测所得的状态码与标题会随时间变化**，**故本词条不主张任何具体探测结果的时效性**；**⑦ 是否有中文材料本次未核实**；**⑧** 本词条**不主张**该数据集涵盖 `.bank.in` 等命名空间的全部子域名**。**核实说明**：`https://api.github.com/repos/CCAgentOrg/bank-in-domains` 与 `/readme` 于 2026-09-11 经 GitHub API 实测读取（README 徽章数值已逐字核对）；**未下载数据、未访问其自述主页**。
e.body_en:
**bank-in-domains** is a **daily domain-layer probe dataset for Indian financial namespaces** (repository `CCAgentOrg/bank-in-domains`), with **measured ★10, 2 forks, Python as the primary language, a 4,007 KB repository, created 2026-06-07 and last pushed 2026-09-10** (**all GitHub API measurements**); **its self-described homepage measurably reads `zo.pub/cashlessconsumer/bank-domains-status`**. It belongs to the third of this round’s four approaches to verifiability: **relying on continuous measurement**.

Verifiable details (**all measured verbatim from the GitHub API and README**): the **README measures 11,172 bytes**, stating verbatim **"Audit of Indian financial namespace TLDs. Daily probes of `.bank.in`, `.fin.in`, `.insurance.in`, `.nbfc.in`, `.npci.in`, and the global `.bank` gTLD — DNS resolution, HTTPS reachability, status codes, page titles, and final URLs."** — **i.e. daily probing of DNS resolution, HTTPS reachability, status codes, page titles and final URLs across these namespaces**. ⭐ **Three key figures are given verbatim as README badges**: **License: CC0-1.0**, **Updated Daily** and **Entries 4,199**; **with format badges for CSV, JSONL, Parquet and SQLite**; **a "Built with Zo" badge is also measurable**. ⭐ **The README states verbatim why it exists**: **"`.bank.in` is the de-facto namespace for Indian banking web presences, but no authoritative registry publishes a subdomain list. This audit discovers and [monitors]"** — **i.e. `.bank.in` is the de-facto namespace for Indian banking web presences, yet no authoritative registry publishes its subdomain list, so this audit discovers and continuously monitors it**.

For RIAA: **① ⭐⭐⭐ "No authoritative registry publishes a list, so it must be measured continuously" is the round’s most methodologically valuable point** — **a solution to the common predicament of having no official roster: do not guess and do not cite a second-hand list, but probe daily and publish the results**; **for actuarial and insurance students this pattern transfers widely** (**for example, "which institutions really offer a given product" or "which regulator pages are really reachable" — and every entry on the site this entry lives on was built by exactly this kind of repeated measurement**). **② ⭐⭐ `.insurance.in` appears directly in the probed scope** — **an Indian namespace for insurance-industry web presences, listed alongside `.bank.in`, `.nbfc.in` (non-banking financial companies) and `.npci.in` (National Payments Corporation of India)**; **for students of the Indian insurance market or financial supervision this is an infrastructure perspective the corpus lacked** (**readable with [[irdai-sbsr-regulations]], [[irdai-market-statistics]] and [[irdai-ai-governance]] — those are IRDAI’s rules, statistics and AI governance, whereas this adds whether those institutions’ web presences resolve and are reachable at all**; **"the regulator issued a document" and "the regulator’s site is actually alive" are two different things**). **③ ⭐⭐ Together, DNS resolution, HTTPS reachability, status codes, page titles and final URLs constitute a mechanised version of the verification workflow this site performs by hand** — **especially final URLs: where a redirect actually lands often differs from the nominal URL, the same risk class as the domain-level near-misses recurring in this project (round 310 `gfia.org`, round 317 `cios.org`)**; **this dataset makes "who does this domain actually point to" a daily routine measurement**. **④ ⭐ 4,199 entries across four formats (CSV, JSONL, Parquet, SQLite) make it directly analysable** — **covering tabular, streaming, columnar and query use cases** (**readable with [[open-risk-api]], [[risk-data-library-standard]] and [[cybrisk]]**). **⑤ ⭐ "Updated Daily" via GitHub Actions is a low-cost continuous-measurement architecture** — **the same family as [[daily-news-report]] and [[continuous-monitoring-ai-risk]], which turn measurement into a pipeline instead of a one-off** (**the workflow file was not inspected, so its implementation is not restated**).

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **① ⚠️ The licence has conflicting sources, recorded side by side**: **the GitHub API measurably returns `NOASSERTION` (name `Other`)**, **while the README badge measurably reads `License: CC0-1.0`** — **the two disagree**; **the entry records both and advises checking the repository’s actual licence file and terms before reuse** (**asserting neither that it is CC0 nor that it is unusable**). **②** this check verified **the repository metadata, the full 11,172-byte README and the badge values and descriptions quoted verbatim**, ⭐ **but downloaded no data file, opened no record from the CSV, JSONL, Parquet or SQLite outputs, and did not visit its stated homepage `zo.pub/cashlessconsumer/bank-domains-status`**, so **its field definitions, the actual composition of the 4,199 entries, probe success rates and historical coverage cannot be restated**; **③ ⭐ "Entries 4,199" and "Updated Daily" are README badge self-reports**, **and neither the data files (to verify the count) nor the commit history (to verify daily updating) were checked**; **④ "no authoritative registry publishes a subdomain list" is the project’s own judgement** — **the entry does not claim it is independently confirmed** (**it is exactly the kind of institutional claim a reader should check**); **⑤ the collection method, the exact probing frequency and whether target sites’ access policies are respected were not verified**; **⑥ probed status codes and titles change over time**, **so no specific probe result is claimed to be current**; **⑦ whether Chinese-language material exists was not verified**; **⑧** this entry **does not claim the dataset covers every subdomain of these namespaces**. **Verification note**: `https://api.github.com/repos/CCAgentOrg/bank-in-domains` and `/readme` were read via the GitHub API on 2026-09-11 (badge values checked verbatim); **no data was downloaded and its stated homepage was not visited**.

**bank-in-domains** 是一份**印度金融命名空間的域名層每日探測數據集**（倉庫 `CCAgentOrg/bank-in-domains`），**實測 ★10、fork 2、主語言 Python、體量 4,007 KB、創建於 2026-06-07、最後推送 2026-09-10**；**其自述主頁實測為 `zo.pub/cashlessconsumer/bank-domains-status`**。本條目屬本輪主題**「可核實性的四種做法」**中的**第三種：靠持續測量（measurement）****。

可核實資訊（**均由 GitHub API 與 README 逐字實測**）：**README 實測 11,172 位元組**，要點逐字為 **「Audit of Indian financial namespace TLDs. Daily probes of `.bank.in`, `.fin.in`, `.insurance.in`, `.nbfc.in`, `.npci.in`, and the global `.bank` gTLD — DNS resolution, HTTPS reachability, status codes, page titles, and final URLs.」**。⭐ **README 徽章逐字實測給出三項關鍵指標**：**License: CC0-1.0**、**Updated Daily**、**Entries 4,199**；**並提供格式徽章 CSV / JSONL / Parquet / SQLite**。⭐ **README 逐字說明其存在原因**：**「`.bank.in` is the de-facto namespace for Indian banking web presences, but no authoritative registry publishes a subdomain list. This audit discovers and…」**。

對 RIAA：**① ⭐⭐⭐ 「權威登記機構不公布清單，所以只能自己持續測量」是本輪最有方法論價值的一條**——**不去猜、不引用二手名單，而是每天自己探一遍並公開結果**；**本站的每一條目也是靠這種逐次實測建立的**。**② ⭐⭐ `.insurance.in` 直接出現在探測範圍內**——**即存在一個**面向保險業網絡存在的印度命名空間****，與 `.bank.in`、`.nbfc.in`（非銀行金融公司）、`.npci.in` 並列（可與 [[irdai-sbsr-regulations]]、[[irdai-market-statistics]]、[[irdai-ai-governance]] 並讀——**「監管者發過文件」與「監管者的網站真的活著」是兩件事**）。**③ ⭐⭐ 五項探測合起來，正好構成本站驗證流程的機器化版本**——**尤其「最終 URL」：落點常與名義 URL 不同**，與本項目反覆出現的**域名級近失**（第 310 輪 `gfia.org`、第 317 輪 `cios.org`）同屬一類風險。**④ ⭐ 「Entries 4,199」與四種格式說明它是**可直接用於分析**的形態**（可與 [[open-risk-api]]、[[risk-data-library-standard]]、[[cybrisk]] 並讀）。**⑤ ⭐ 「Updated Daily」由 GitHub Actions 實現，是低成本持續測量架構**（可與 [[daily-news-report]]、[[continuous-monitoring-ai-risk]] 並讀）。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**① ⚠️ 許可存在**來源衝突，須並列如實記錄****：**GitHub API 實測返回 `NOASSERTION`（name 為 `Other`）**，**而 README 徽章逐字實測為 `License: CC0-1.0`**——**兩者不一致**；**本詞條並列記錄，並提示：引用該數據前應自行核對倉庫中的實際許可文件與條款**。**②** 本次核實到**倉庫元數據、README 全文（11,172 位元組）與其中逐字引用的徽章數值與描述**，⭐ **但未下載任何數據文件、未打開任何一條記錄、未訪問其自述主頁**，故**不能轉述其欄位定義、4,199 條的實際構成、探測成功率或歷史覆蓋**；**③ ⭐ 「Entries 4,199」與「Updated Daily」均為**README 徽章自述值**，**未核對數據文件驗證條數，也未核對提交歷史驗證是否真的每日更新**；**④ 「no authoritative registry publishes a subdomain list」為**項目自述判斷**，**不主張該判斷已被獨立證實**；**⑤ 採集方式、探測頻率精確值、是否遵守目標站點訪問策略未核實**；**⑥ 探測所得的狀態碼與標題會隨時間變化，故不主張任何具體探測結果的時效性**；**⑦ 是否有中文材料未核實**；**⑧** 本詞條**不主張**該數據集涵蓋全部子域名**。**核實說明**：`https://api.github.com/repos/CCAgentOrg/bank-in-domains` 與 `/readme` 於 2026-09-11 經 GitHub API 實測讀取；**未下載數據、未訪問其自述主頁**。
